title: Who is Sai Pallavi’s family? Meet her parents and younger sister
description: Sai Pallavi, celebrated for her remarkable performances in acclaimed films, hails from a family outside the film industry. Her father, Senthamarai Kannan, is a former football player and Central Excise officer, while her mother, Radha Kannan, nurtured her dancer's dream from a young age, encouraging her in initial performances. Her younger sister, Pooja Kannan, has started an acting career and recently wedded in a low-key ceremony in 2024.

title: Shraddha's musical roots: Maternal ties link her to Mangeshkars

title: Kusha Kapila's ex-husband Zorawar opens up about failed marriage, lost job and house
description: Zorawar Singh Ahluwalia has made his return to social media, sharing a heartfelt video that reflects on his recent struggles. He opened up about the emotional toll of his separation from Kusha Kapila, as well as the accompanying challenges of job loss and diminished self-esteem. Zorawar emphasized his commitment to personal growth and his understanding of life's setbacks while offering encouragement to others who may be experiencing similar hardships.

title: Sai Pallavi joins Sri Sathya Sai Baba’s centenary celebrations in Puttaparthi

She was seen engaging in bhajans, walking and singing with fellow devotees during the event. Her latest films, 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' and 'O.M: Operation Mole,' have been performing well at the box office. title: 'Happy to be back again': Tiger Shroff on returning to stage more than month after attack on his car

This first part concludes with Sita’s abduction, setting up a sequel focused on her rescue.

title: A look into Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s family: All about how the tight-end’s brother, Jason Kelce's, daughters support their dad
description: Ever since Taylor Swift has been in a relationship with Travis Kelce, both of them have gotten quite close with each other’s family members. The two brothers actually run their own podcast together, on which Swift has featured as a guest as well. The entire family shares quite a close bond, which has only gotten stronger since the pair decided to get married earlier this year in July.Here is a look into Jason Kelce, Kylie Kelce, and their four daughters, all of whom have sung praises of the ‘Opalite’ singer at one point or another.

Varma draws parallels with historical figures like Napoleon and Stalin, pointing out that muscular figures frequently serve under less physically imposing leaders.
